==Description==
'''Super Computer Parts''' were items that appeared in [[The Nightmare Realm]] as part of the [[Hexscape Event]].

Upon starting the match, eight '''Super Computer Parts''' were scattered at various places across the map near the Super Computer. Players could spend varying amounts of cash to repair the Super Computer found at the map's exit. Buying all eight '''Super Computer Parts''' completed the [[The Nightmare Realm#Objective|objective]], which heavily reduced the health of the map's final boss, the [[Conserver]]. 

Each of the eight '''Super Computer Parts''' required a different amount of money to purchase, costing {{Money|500}}, {{Money|1,000}}, {{Money|2,500}}, {{Money|5,000}}, {{Money|7,500}}, {{Money|10,000}}, {{Money|15,000}} and {{Money|20,000}} respectively. All parts had a total cost of {{Money|61,500}}.

==Appearance==
There were three different types of '''Super Computer Parts''', each with a different appearance. The first type of part resembled a server, with a long, flat body with ports at each end to power and connect the server to the mainframe. The second type of part resembled a miniature display setup, with a bolted panel and a small screen that functioned as a display. The third type of part resembled an antenna, with two thin rods bolted into a receiver that was attached to the side of the Super Computer. 

==Strategy==
*Because the '''Super Computer Parts''' can be bought on any wave before the final wave, it is best to reserve buying them all until Wave 18 or 19, where cash is more abundant. 
**[[Dispatcher]] will remind the players to buy parts, though this does not mean they have to be bought.

==Trivia==
*[https://www.roblox.com/users/31164652/profile#!/about Enthrallist] created the sound effects for the '''Super Computer''' using an electromagnetic microphone recording and an Xbox 360.
